Miking uses retained posterior moments where
available; wheels, outlier, SLAM and hybrid
* Miking static gtree has recorded posterior bias.
Hybrid mean error alone cannot verify its
All plotted points summarize five successful runs.
See README.md for sources and timing boundaries.
Matching particle counts and identical logarithmic axes in every panel
Connected markers follow increasing particle count.
Siren/SirenC timing includes particle creation, execution and weighted means. Miking inference excludes final mixture aggregation.
Siren/SirenC rerun sequentially; CorePPL was not rerun. Cross-system timing boundaries and machine conditions differ.
